spec.description: Fetch one pre-built summary feed: every earthquake over a magnitude threshold in the past hour, day, week or month.

feed.description: Feed name: a magnitude threshold and a time span joined by an underscore. `significant` is USGS's own significance score rather than a magnitude, and `all` is every located event, which for `all_month` is a large document.

response.description: Every earthquake the feed covers, newest first.

notes: The path template carries the file extension outside the placeholder (`{feed}.geojson`), because the extension is the format, not part of the feed name.
A feed regenerates every minute and is cached at the edge, so two recordings of the same feed made minutes apart differ. That is what the feed is; an example records one moment of it.
`significant_day` and `significant_hour` are frequently empty. An empty `features` array with no `bbox` is a normal answer, not an error, which is why `bbox` is optional.
